_note: This file is a DECLARATION, not a control. Each record RESTATES a glob list that lives in the module named by owner_module/owner_constant; those modules remain the single source of truth, and NO hook imports this file. That direction is deliberate: a hook that read its globs from here would make the drift check comparing the two a tautology, proving only that a file equals itself. Nothing here gates a tool call. tools/hooks/commit_gate.py is deliberately absent from domains[]: it is a PreToolUse(Bash) gate that enumerates NO paths — it has no glob set to declare, so giving it a record would invent a path-deny domain that does not exist. Every domain's uncovered_tool_surfaces names Bash for the same honesty: a shell command can reach these paths without passing any of these gates, and that gap is recorded as data rather than left to prose.

Reading it as the secret domain would overstate what the gate denies by five patterns.
